product.olivetti-echos-p75.summary: The Echos P75 in the Italian Pentium line with a 10.4-inch display.
product.olivetti-echos-p75.history: MCmicrocomputer documented the Echos P75 in December 1995 in Olivetti’s multimedia Echos P line. It listed an Italian price of 5,600,000 lire excluding VAT.
product.olivetti-echos-p75.architecture: The display defined this configuration. The Italian listing specifies DSTN · 10.4″ and a 510 MB disk.
product.olivetti-echos-p75.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p75.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
